description: Turns a seed topic into candidate prompts worth tracking (real Google/Bing autocomplete completions reframed as questions) plus observed mention-rate signals from this project's own already-tracked prompts. This is NOT prompt search volume — no honest corpus of 'how many people ask this' exists anywhere this codebase can reach, so no volume or difficulty number is invented. FREE: no AI-gateway budget, no paid-plan gate, no credits spent.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

seedTopic.description: Topic to derive trackable prompt candidates from.

name: research_ai_prompts
